text:
noah: deploy-bot flagged the rollout for billing-api: chart version vs values image mismatch after canary in eu-west. @emma can you triage? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Promotion ID prom-20260322-09 paused. Reason: Helm values indicate image.tag=v3.1.0 but chart.lock references v3.0.9 (digest mismatch). Canary observed in us-east; eu-west canary pods show older digest. See: /deploy/prom-20260322-09/summary

emma: checking. looks like the chart maintainer bumped values in the umbrella chart but didn't update the chart.lock for the subchart registry replication. robots re-tagged v3.1.0 in one registry only.

sre-oncall: change window closes in 40m. if we wait for registry sync that might miss the window. options: 1) pin values.image.digest to the eu digest and promote, 2) revert umbrella chart to chart.lock v3.0.9 and re-run canary, 3) abort and re-run later.

noah: what's risk if we pin? any migrations in v3.1.0?

emma: v3.1.0 has a metrics label rename but no DB migration. risk low for runtime. pin keeps exactly what eu canary saw. I'll prepare a values-override PR setting `image.digest` and include canary verification steps.

ops: prefer pin+promote given window. include a note to flip to v3.1.0 tag after registries converge.

release-lead: agree with pin. add rollback steps to the PR and post a short message to #release-notes explaining root cause and that this is a republishing issue.

emma: PR created: https://git.redwood/billing/compare/pin-eu-digest-20260322 (CI running). PR description includes rollback playbook and quick verification:
```
# verify pods
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=billing -o wide
# rollout status
kubectl -n prod rollout status sts/billing --timeout=5m
# if issues
helm rollback billing <previous_revision> --namespace prod
```

noah: CI green. ready for manual promote. tagging @release-lead and @sre-oncall for final ack. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Manual ack required. Use `deploy-bot promote --id prom-20260322-09 --manual-ack <user>` to continue.

release-lead: approved. I will run the promote.

sre-oncall: standing by to monitor logs/metrics for 30m. set up temporary alert for 5xx spike and pod restarts.

noah: running promote now.

deploy-bot: Promotion prom-20260322-09 proceeding (manual ack by release-lead).

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. prod-eu billing-api now running pinned digest sha256:9f7a12...; rollout 4/4 ready.

emma: posting release note: "Release coordination: pinned billing-api image digest in prod to avoid cross-registry tag drift during chart promotion. No functional changes. Follow-up: add registry-consistency check in release CI." will publish to #release-notes.

ops: opened follow-up ticket to add chart.lock verification and image replication check: https://git.redwood/infra/issues/492. assigning to infra squad.

release-lead: closing thread. thanks all. :clap:
